planets.name: TOI-1173 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1173 with a 7.06-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1173 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1173. Its orbit and size follow Yee & Vissapragada 2026's fit, the archive's default.
